title: Delivery Service Courtesy on Delivery Claims Found-Parcel Charges
content:
Under Delivery Claims, a found-parcel charge carries a courtesy for the delivery service the parcel was sent by.

**Courtesy.** The service courtesy depends on the delivery service the parcel was sent by: Next Business Day or Same-Day Courier gives 10%, Expedited 2-Day gives 5%, and any other service gives none.

| Delivery service on the order | Service courtesy |
|---|---|
| Next Business Day | 10% |
| Same-Day Courier | 10% |
| Expedited 2-Day | 5% |
| Economy Ground, Pickup Point Delivery, Standard Ground | none |

*Hypothetical:* a found parcel from a Standard Ground order carries no service courtesy; the same parcel sent by Expedited 2-Day would carry 5%.
